2607.15277.title: Partition, Prompt, Aggregate: Statistical Self-Consistency in Language Models
2607.15277.paper_summary: In-context learning is commonly interpreted as a form of conditional inference, in which the prompt specifies a context and the model's output is treated as an estimate of the corresponding conditional distribution. If this interpretation holds, then LLM estimates should satisfy basic probabilistic identities. In particular, the law of total probability asserts that prior-weighted conditional distributions aggregate into population-level marginals over any valid partition of the population. In this work, we investigate to what extent LLM estimates adhere to this self-consistency principle. We use binary trees as an evaluation scaffold to recursively partition a population into increasingly fine-grained subpopulations. We then prompt LLMs with verbalized subpopulation descriptions in context, aggregate the resulting estimates back into population-level estimates, and compare them across partitions of varying granularity. Applying this protocol across problem domains and state-of-the-art frontier models, we show widespread violations of basic consistency properties. An in-depth study of persona prompting reveals a pattern we call the macro fallacy: estimates reconstructed from more fine-grained subpopulation responses are often better aligned with human reference data than direct population-level estimates. This effect persists across variations in tree structure and estimation task, and can be partially recovered through implicit prompting. Together, these findings suggest that models possess relevant subpopulation knowledge but do not reliably propagate it into aggregate estimates. This gap establishes statistical self-consistency as an unsaturated, reference-free criterion for evaluating LLMs.
2607.15277.paper_summary_zh: 在上下文學習中，通常被解釋為一種條件推理的形式，其中提示指定了一個上下文，模型的輸出被視為對應條件分佈的估計。<lb/>如果這種解釋成立，那麼大型語言模型（LLM）的估計應該滿足基本的概率性身份。<lb/>特別是，總概率法則聲稱，先前加權的條件分佈在任何有效的人口劃分中聚合成整體水平的邊際分佈。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們研究LLM的估計在多大程度上遵循這一自我一致性原則。<lb/>我們使用二叉樹作為評估框架，遞歸地將一個人口劃分為越來越細的子群體。<lb/>然後，我們用語言化的子群體描述在上下文中提示LLM，將產生的估計聚合回整體水平的估計，並在不同粒度的劃分中進行比較。<lb/>在不同問題領域和最先進的前沿模型中應用這一協議，我們顯示出基本一致性特性的大規模違反。<lb/>對角色提示的深入研究揭示了一種我們稱之為宏觀謬誤的模式：從更細粒度的子群體反應重建的估計，通常比直接的人口水平估計更好地與人類參考數據對齊。<lb/>這一效應在樹結構和估計任務的變化中持續存在，並且可以通過隱性提示部分恢復。<lb/>綜合這些發現表明，模型擁有相關的子群體知識，但並不可靠地將其傳播到聚合估計中。<lb/>這一差距確立了統計自我一致性作為評估LLM的一個未飽和、無參考標準。
